title: Keyword: Borrow<str> + Deref enables HashMap<Keyword,bool> queries with bare &str
description: Keyword implements Borrow<str>, Deref<Target=str>, and AsRef<str>. This allows HashMap<Keyword,bool> to be queried with a constant &str (contains_key(SEEN)) without allocating. A future contributor might simplify to HashMap<String,bool> or remove Deref, breaking this ergonomics. The Borrow<str> impl is load-bearing and must be preserved.
